rewrites.//: Shareable brief pages are server-rendered by the backend, because a link-preview crawler does not run JavaScript. Point the destination at your API host and uncomment; until then /c/* falls through to the SPA and previews as the generic site card. See PREVIEW.md.

The brand's own public page, server-rendered for the same reason and reached from every campaign card. Point this at the API host alongside /c/:id — they are one feature and shipping one without the other means a link into a page that does not exist.

The brand-facing pitch page, server-rendered by the backend like /c/:id and /brands/:id — this is the link that goes to a venue owner on WhatsApp, so its preview and its speed both matter. Point the destination at your API host alongside the other two.
Lists every public brand page and live brief, so a crawler has something to follow. robots.txt names it, so both have to point at the same host.
